join_order.notes: max custkey ~1.5M, dense bitmap feasible (187KB fits L1). Scan orders checking bitmap + o_orderdate filter.
Use lineitem_l_orderkey_grouped index for O(1) lookup per qualifying orderkey. Contiguous lineitem rows enable sequential reads.

orders_qualifying.description: Parallel-collected arrays of (o_orderkey, o_orderdate, o_shippriority) for qualifying orders

aggregation.notes: ~500K groups. Per-thread local maps, merge at end.

order_metadata.description: dense_pk_array lookup[orderkey] → (o_orderdate, o_shippriority) for final output
order_metadata.notes: Store o_orderdate and o_shippriority for qualifying orders so they can be retrieved by l_orderkey during output phase

execution_steps.name: build_customer_bitmap
execution_steps.operation: Load c_mktsegment dictionary, find code for :c_mktsegment_eq. Scan c_mktsegment column, set bit in bitmap for each qualifying c_custkey.

execution_steps.name: scan_orders_with_filter
execution_steps.operation: Parallel scan orders. For each row: check o_orderdate < :o_orderdate_upper AND customer_bitmap[o_custkey]. Qualifying orders: store o_orderkey into per-thread arrays. Also populate order_metadata arrays indexed by o_orderkey for o_orderdate and o_shippriority.

execution_steps.name: probe_lineitem_and_aggregate
execution_steps.operation: For each qualifying o_orderkey from step 1: use lineitem_l_orderkey_grouped index to get (start, count). For each lineitem row in [start, start+count): check l_shipdate > :l_shipdate_lower. If passes, accumulate l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) into per-thread hash map keyed by l_orderkey.

execution_steps.name: merge_and_topk
execution_steps.operation: Merge per-thread aggregation maps. Find top :limit entries by (revenue DESC, o_orderdate ASC) using partial_sort or priority queue. Look up o_orderdate and o_shippriority from order_metadata for output.

indexes.purpose: O(1) lookup of contiguous lineitem rows per orderkey, avoiding full lineitem scan
skip_blocks where max_date <= :l_shipdate_lower (not primary strategy since index_nested_loop already targets specific rows)

aggregation.note: l_orderkey functionally determines o_orderdate and o_shippriority via the join, so hash only on l_orderkey
aggregation.merge_strategy: iterate smaller maps, insert-or-add into largest map

parallelism.step1_partitioning: chunk orders rows across threads (morsel size ~65536)
